subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: Should OpenClaw graduate/default-on session transcript indexing now, or keep it experimental until source policy, privacy scope, ranking, and duplicate-indexing blockers are resolved?
rationale: The current implementation works as an opt-in path, but changing the default or stable contract controls raw transcript exposure, cost, and cross-channel retrieval semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep Experimental For Now
options.body: Leave the current opt-in behavior in place and use the linked blockers as graduation criteria before changing defaults or stable docs.

options.title: Sponsor A Staged Graduation
options.body: Approve a maintainer-owned plan that first documents source policy and privacy scope, then changes config/docs after live gateway, QMD, reset/new, and duplicate-indexing validation.

options.title: Redirect To sessions_search
options.body: Treat stable transcript lookup as the new `sessions_search` direction and keep semantic session recall as an advanced memory-search mode.

recommendation.title: Keep Experimental For Now
recommendation.body: Leave the current opt-in behavior in place and use the linked blockers as graduation criteria before changing defaults or stable docs.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the experimental session-memory source and opened the adjacent maintainer issue for a core `sessions_search` alternative.
